title: Micron Stock (MU) Falls 1.0% After Nvidia Earnings (Nov 18)
summary: Micron (MU) fell 1.00% to $705.27 on Nov 18 as an early gain after Nvidia's results faded and Nvidia shares slipped 2.89%.
body_markdown:
## Why Micron Stock Fell


Financial media tied Micron's session to Nvidia's quarterly report. After the close on November 17,[Nvidia's fiscal third-quarter report](https://www.heygotrade.com/en/news/after-nvidia-retailers-and-fed-minutes/) showed revenue of $115.8 billion, up 103% from a year earlier, according to[the company's official release](https://www.sec.gov/Archives/edgar/data/0001045810/000104581026000088/q3fy27pr.htm) . As reported by[GuruFocus](https://finance.yahoo.com/markets/stocks/articles/micron-stocks-rise-1-7-194453345.html) , Micron moved higher in[premarket trading](https://www.heygotrade.com/en/learn/us-stock-market-hours-open-and-close-times/) on November 18 as the memory complex rose after those results.


The lift faded once regular trading got going. Nvidia gave up its early gains and closed at $150.96, down 2.89%, as investors turned to succession uncertainty and China-related regulatory scrutiny, according to[the Motley Fool](https://www.fool.com/coverage/stock-market-today/2026/11/18/stock-market-today-nov-18-nvidia-slips-on-strong-results-as-succession-and-china-business-risks-weigh/) . Per[Barron's](https://finance.yahoo.com/m/dfd72c7d-a0e5-3183-be07-91983664b076/3-catalysts-set-to-boost.html) , "Micron stock isn't getting a boost from Nvidia earnings."


## MU Stock Analysis: Supporting Factors and Risks


### Supporting Factors


- Micron guided fiscal first-quarter 2027 revenue to $61.5 billion, plus or minus $1.5 billion, after fiscal fourth-quarter revenue of $54.23 billion, according to[its September 30 results release](https://www.sec.gov/Archives/edgar/data/0000723125/000072312526000018/a2026q4ex991-pressrelease.htm) , in which CEO Sanjay Mehrotra said "we expect an even stronger fiscal 2027."
- President Scott DeBoer said at an October 21 webinar that Micron doesn't "see a period of time where memory is not going to be in short supply in the next two years," as reported by[the Motley Fool](https://finance.yahoo.com/markets/stocks/articles/micron-undervalued-204102508.html) .
- GuruFocus, citing TECHi, reported that Nvidia's commitments for memory and foundry supply rose to $390 billion from $279 billion, with most of the increase reflecting multi-year memory purchases.


### Risks


- Micron's annual report shows yearly swings in average selling prices over five years ranging from "an increase of approximately 200% to a decrease of approximately 50%," and the company warns prices may fall as it and its rivals add supply, per the Motley Fool.
- Micron expects to spend about $25 billion on new factories and equipment in the first half of fiscal 2027, the Motley Fool reported, adding to the industry supply growth the company itself flags as a pricing risk.
- More than half of fiscal 2026 revenue came from Micron's top 10 customers, according to the Motley Fool, which ties results closely to a small group of buyers.


Micron's next quarterly[earnings report](https://www.heygotrade.com/en/learn/how-to-read-an-earnings-report/) is expected in December, according to GuruFocus; the sources reviewed carry no confirmed date, so that timing is an estimate.
